text:
Ravi CSM: heads-up — noticed three accounts (Brightline, OrchID, CedarOps) have steady usage erosion over 3 weeks. not a sudden crash but worrying. proposing a 'staggered saveflow' to intercept before we talk downgrade. thoughts? :wave:

Sasha Enablement: quick +1. what does staggered saveflow mean operationally?

Ravi CSM: short version: progressive value-reinforcement + tactical concessions. goal = recover core engagement without immediate pricing moves. plan sketch:
- day 0: CSM reach + 20m checkin focused on top-3 use cases
- day 3: deliver personalized quick-win doc + short how-to clip
- day 7: apply 2-week grace credits for quota if they confirm re-engage
- day 14: enable a feature spotlight (free trial of advanced route) to re-trigger usage
- day 21: if still low, present downgrade options + recommendation for retention offer

Diego AM: love the credits idea. need guardrails — avoid giving credits to accounts in past-due state. can we require account health score >= 40?

Ravi CSM: yes — the flow will check health score and billing status before granting credits. will only target accounts with recent adoption signals but falling MAU.

Nora PM: add a short feedback capture at day 0 and day 7: single-question survey "What stopped you from using feature Y?" store answers in the retention sheet. helps product.

Sasha Enablement: I'll run the 20m check-ins for Brightline and CedarOps. Ravi take OrchID?

Ravi CSM: yep I'll own OrchID. Sasha — can you prep the quick-win doc template? 1 page, checklist, 3 screenshots.

OpsBot: automation blueprint created:
```
trigger: sliding_window_3w_decline
conditions:
  - health_score >= 40
  - billing_status == current
workflow: staggered_saveflow_v2
steps:
  - notify: CSM + AM + Enablement
  - schedule_meet: day0: 0-3d
  - deliver_doc: day3
  - apply_credits: day7 if confirm_reengage
  - enable_trial_feature: day14
  - escalate_downgrade_offer: day21
```
Dry-run queued on staging. will post results in #cs-ops-log. :gear:

Diego AM: messaging check — can we keep outreach tone: "we noticed lower activity, want to help you get back to value" not pricing yet. i'll draft two variants: conversational and executive.

Ravi CSM: perfect. please tag me on the drafts. action items:
- Ravi: OrchID outreach + log feedback (due in 48h)
- Sasha: run check-ins for Brightline & CedarOps + create quick-win doc template (ETA 24h)
- Diego: draft two messaging variants (ETA 12h)
- Nora: add survey column to retention tracker and map answers to tags (blocking, confusion, cost)
- OpsBot: run staging dry-run and report success/failures

Sasha Enablement: adding note — for accounts that accept trial feature, create a short success checklist to track conversion.

Ravi CSM: if dry-run looks good we'll roll to the next 20 accounts with similar profile. want to avoid knee-jerk downgrades and collect better signals. thanks team. :seedling:
